d: [Branded Content] In a bid to understand the origins of a motorcycle, you actually have to ride one. Varun Painter went out to Bengaluru where he met Dhananjay, an avid motorcyclist who also happens to own a Triumph 3HW. The 3 stands for a 350cc engine, the H for an overhead camshaft and W for war. Straight from the 40s, living in peace and being ridden well in 2026. Time to find out what made this motorcycle special.
